title: Maintainer action: submit the SAML error-cause patch to better-auth upstream (split from #31168)
body:
sweep#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYJqoPAoSpWTMpH1yq

Source: maintainer — Warren, 2026-11-19 00:32Z in the objectstack priorities discussion thread: 「可以拆的都同意。」 (the split list's item 3: move #31168's upstream PR to its own maintainer card). Earlier: 2026-11-07 23:56Z 「31168 转维护者处理卡片」「我换账户提交」 (recorded on #31168, comment 6714742026). Rule: #35259 item 7.

Filing gate: ③ a task the maintainer dispatched. Reader: the maintainer (his other GitHub account). Dedupe: open cards naming better-auth upstream SAML — none besides #31168.

Grade: p2 · area:ux · Task · inherits #31168's grade

## Why

#31168 (SAML refusals name their cause) waits on @better-auth/sso keeping samlify's error cause. The patch, the PR text and the checks were drafted on #31168 (2026-11-07; drafted against better-auth `main` `ba59f5d8ec`). Submitting them upstream is the maintainer's step; #31168 now points its `Blocked-by:` here.

Maintainer-action: run the upstream checks in `notes.md` and submit `upstream-pr.md` + `upstream.patch` (project files `issue-31168/`, drafted against better-auth `main` `ba59f5d8ec`) to better-auth/better-auth from the maintainer's other account — done when an upstream PR URL is on this card

## After

Close this card with the URL. #31168 then waits on the upstream release (`pm:on-hold` with `Restart-when:` an @better-auth/sso release carrying the fix); the two-week clock of ruling 6709033929 starts on the submission date.
